audience: gym and fitness club managers who track membership and sales figures in GymMaster

useCases.title: Check member numbers for a period
useCases.text: List the KPI field names. Then read the values of fields such as current members and new memberships for a date range.

useCases.title: Read whole KPI categories over a date range
useCases.text: List the KPI categories, such as member statistics or sales. Then read their values for a date range.

useCases.title: Run a standard report for a date range
useCases.text: List the standard reports of the club, then run one for a date range. Some member reports include member names.

useCases.title: Check the dashboard figures of a club
useCases.text: List the dashboard widgets, then read the figures of one widget, such as the figures for new members.
